svg.title: Paul's Missionary Journeys | 保罗的宣教旅程
svg.desc: Four schematic panels: three missionary journeys and the voyage to Rome, differentiated by solid, dashed, dotted, and dash-dot routes; locations approximate. / 四个分图以实线、虚线、点线及点划线区分三次宣教及前往罗马的路线。
